item.title: War worsens Lebanon's economic crisis with job losses, price gouging and slow business
item.description: The latest war between Israel and Hamas, and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, have sent economic shock waves across the Mideast

item.title: Death toll in attack on Kyiv apartment building now stands at 24
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that a Russian missile attack on a Kyiv apartment building the previous day killed 24 people, including three children.

item.title: UAE denies Netanyahu held 'secret' meeting with president during Iran war
item.description: ⁠The ⁠United ​Arab Emirates' ​foreign ministry denied on Wednesday the ​reports ‌of ⁠Israeli Prime Minister ‌Benjamin Netanyahu's visit ⁠to the country, adding such claims are "baseless". The Israeli ​PM’s office said earlier Wednesday ​that Netanyahu had held a "secret" meeting with the UAE president during the Israel-US war with ⁠Iran. Read our liveblog to see how all the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Iran warns US to accept peace plan or risk collapse of Mideast truce
item.description: Iran’s chief negotiator said on Tuesday that Washington must accept Tehran’s latest peace plan or risk the collapse of the Middle East truce, after President Donald Trump warned the ceasefire was near failure. The war, triggered by US-Israeli strikes on Iran more than two months ago, has destabilised the region and rattled global markets.

item.title: In Lebanon, the idea of peace with Israel continues to deeply divide opinion
item.description: In Lebanon, the very idea of peace with Israel continues to deeply divide opinion. As unprecedented negotiations open today in Washington under US mediation, many Lebanese see a chance for a return to stability. But within Hezbollah’s camp, any normalisation with Israel is firmly rejected. FRANCE 24's Serge Berberi and Renee Davis report.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Israeli report says Hamas used 'systematic, widespread' sexual violence in October 7 attack
item.description: A report released on Tuesday by an independent Israeli investigative commission found that sexual violence was a "central component" of Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack on Israel and of the captivity of the hostages that the militant group took back to Gaza.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

item.title: Trump faces split among retired US commanders over whether to resume Iran strikes
item.description: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on "massive life support" as retired U.S. commanders debate whether to resume military operations against Tehran.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".
